outcome: kinetics of placental fatty acid transfer
fatty acid fractional synthesis rate (FSR) in placenta
cohort: The study included 10 pregnant women with a body mass index >30 and 10 pregnant women with a body mass index in the range 20-25, all undergoing elective caesarean section.
finding: Computational modelling of materno-fetal fatty acid transfer demonstrated a good fit when all maternal plasma lipid classes (including VLDL and other lipoproteins) were included, rather than just non-esterified FA, revealing an estimated materno-fetal 13C-FA transfer of approximately 1%, with no observed differences in placental FA fractional synthesis rate between normal weight and normo-lipidemic obese pregnant women.
